resources.string: Enter the address of your Rubinny server. The screen then shows a code: enter it in Rubinny under Screens › Add screen.
Enter the full https address of your server, for example https://signage.example.com
On Android 10 and newer, the player can open by itself after a restart only if you allow “Display over other apps”, or if you choose Rubinny Player as the home app.
This device has no such setting. Choose Rubinny Player as the home app instead (Settings › Apps › Default apps › Home app).
The player will open by itself after a restart.
To return to this page from the player, press Back five times quickly.
